# Assets · Icons

60 files under `assets/Icons/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for activity.svg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

# Icons

24 px grid, 1.75 px stroke, round caps and joins, 2 px corners. The files are drawn in ink `#111114` for preview; in the product they are inline SVG with `stroke="currentColor"`, so they take `text`, `text-muted` or `accent-*-line`. Chevrons and back mirror in RTL.
